correctness.rationale: The exact Merca identity reduces the normalized sequence to one quarter of a multiplicative divisor sum plus a divisor-count-sized correction. CRT yields an absolutely convergent double Dirichlet sum, whose odd-prime local factors equal (p²+1)/(p²-1) times finite p^{-3} sums, and whose prime-two local factor has increments -1/8, 15/8^m. Their product gives the full fixed-shift formula and the prime-lag strict comparison; finite combinatorial and numeric checks independently agree. The lambda and CRT boundary errors are O_{h,epsilon}(X^{-1+epsilon}).
